articles.title: Mariners’ Josh Naylor reflects on career-worst MLB season: ‘I didn’t do my part’
articles.description: In 152 games, the Mariners' Josh Naylor ranked as MLB’s worst first baseman in many metrics in 2026, ranking dead last with a minus-0.2 Baseball Reference WAR.

articles.title: Mariners claim Gig Harbor grad Michael Toglia off waivers
articles.description: First baseman-outfielder Michael Toglia is expected to compete for a bench spot on the Mariners’ roster next spring. He may also offer valuable Triple-A depth.

articles.title: Mariners chairman John Stanton on 2026 flop: ‘I’m embarrassed’ | Q&A
articles.description: Mariners chairman John Stanton called the team’s 2026 flop ‘brutal.’ In a Q&A, he discussed the team’s expectations, manager change, payroll budget and more.

articles.title: Three reasons the Mariners are unlikely to re-sign Randy Arozarena
articles.description: Randy Arozarena was the Mariners’ best offensive player and one of the best hitters in baseball. So why aren’t the M’s trying to re-sign him?

articles.title: Jerry Dipoto firing would have been justified, but Mariners’ problems go deeper
articles.description: On the 11th anniversary of his hiring as Mariners GM, Jerry Dipoto explained why they are back where he began in 2015 — 76-86 and in need of fixes.

articles.title: What are Mariners looking for in new manager? Here’s what Jerry Dipoto said.
articles.description: Jerry Dipoto will direct an “exhaustive” search for the Mariners' next manager. Here's what he's looking for and what the timeline will be to fill the role.

articles.title: Mariners broadcaster Rick Rizzs is ‘really ready’ to retire. There will be tears first
articles.description: After 52 years as a baseball broadcaster, 41 of them with his beloved Mariners, Rick Rizzs will call his last game on Sunday. Here's how he's feeling ahead of his retirement.

articles.title: Dan Wilson won’t return as Mariners manager in 2027
articles.description: Dan Wilson informed the Mariners that he won't return in 2027, sources told The Seattle Times. Here's what we know.

articles.title: Mariners place Andrés Muñoz on injured list, ending his season
articles.description: Prior to Friday’s game, the Mariners placed closer Andrés Muñoz on the 15-day injured list with right knee inflammation, ending his season.

articles.title: J.P. Crawford on his Mariners tenure: ‘I owe Seattle everything’
articles.description: J.P. Crawford, who will be a free agent at season's end, could play his final game for the Mariners on Sunday. "I owe this organization everything," he said Saturday.

articles.title: Where does 2026 rank among Mariners’ most disappointing seasons ever?
articles.description: The candidates are plentiful. The dismay runs deep throughout the Mariners’ 50 years. But where does the 2026 season rank among the worst in Seattle's history?
